setup.worker_budget: Serial process groups: 4 GiB virtual address-space per process, 3 GiB aggregate sampled RSS ceiling. Virtual mappings are not resident memory. Leave 5 GiB resident budget for runner, agent and tools. No concurrent build during measured runs.
setup.cache: Warm imports and filesystem cache; every theorem file elaborated afresh. Warmup is retained, excluded from summaries.

solver.license: GPL-3.0; existing separately executed binary, not copied or staged by FFM-19.
solver.qualification_limit: The consumed FFM-09 manifest selects 1.4.1 solving, while FFM-03 text selects 1.3.4 solve. This handoff follows the explicitly consumed FFM-09 executable hash, records the inherited discrepancy, and changes neither pin nor decision. No 1.3.4 or x86_64 rerun claimed.

setup.instrumentation: time.monotonic_ns around fork/exec/wait4; process tree sampled every selector cycle (~10 ms plus /proc scan). Wall time includes launcher, imports, emission, logging and monitoring overhead. Lean cumulative profiler gives exclusive whole-file elaboration, type-checking (kernel), tactic and import components when enabled; not isolated theorem costs.

units.elapsed_seconds: s, whole-file/process wall time including launch and wait observation
units.user_seconds: s, wait4 user CPU including waited descendants
units.system_seconds: s, wait4 system CPU including waited descendants
units.wait4_maxrss_kib: KiB, largest individual-process resident-set high-water mark, not sum of tree peaks
units.sampled_peak_tree_rss_bytes: bytes, sampled sum of RSS in process group; includes shared pages repeatedly, may miss short peaks
units.proof_expr_nodes: recursive Lean.Expr tree node count including binder types and repeated occurrences; referenced constant declarations not unfolded
units.compiled_artifact_bytes: bytes in newly emitted .olean; NOT proof-term size
units.production_stage_seconds: s, existing profileTask wall timer with 1ms resolution; zero means sub-ms rounded stage, not zero-duration successful run
units.lean_profiler_seconds: s, converted from the cumulative exclusive Lean component profiler; elaboration excludes separately labelled tactic/typeclass work; kernel is new-declaration type checking, excludes imports
